Name: Trent's New Animals Treats and Meat (Animal Husbandry Mod)
Author: TrentXV
Description:
Adds meats, treats and custom treats to feed your New Animals (features from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿).
Marnie will sell 3 Random treats per day, these treats can be offered to your animals for roughly 1 straight heart.

Configuration Options:
"AllowArmadilloMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowBuffaloMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowDeerMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowMoleMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowPeafowlMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowSilkwormMeat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowSheepMeat": (true, false) Default: true

This configuration enables the requirement of animal meat and add 5 new recipes.

Mole Meatballs
Armadillo Stew
[b]Peafowl Roast: Makes you invincible for a period
Bison Burguer: Grants +2 Foraging and Speed
Venison Pie: When gifted, gain additional friendship points (only apply to Characters that like it - Won't work on Marnie, Leah, Evelyn, Vincent, Jas, Leo, Krobus and Emily).[/b]

You can also enable treats (added each animal individually so you can remove certain items if you have any of the animals disabled).

"AllowArmadilloTreat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowBuffaloTreat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowDeerTreat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowMoleTreat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowPeafowlTreat": (true, false) Default: true
"AllowSilkwormTreat": (true, false) Default: true

Everyday Marnie may sell treats for your new Animals. If you didn't get any in your shop, try again the next day.

If you are downloading the mod just to be able to give treats to your animals. Disable the AllowMeat options.

As usual, any questions you may contact me through my [url=https://discord.gg/9yjkW9kfVs]discord server[/url]﻿.

Also, as usual, a major Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Digus?gameId=1303]Digus[/url]﻿ for helping me with troubleshooting.
